subject: A white British woman of sixty-nine, seen from the side waist-down through the white stair spindles, coming DOWN her stairs forwards: a navy A-line skirt ending just above the knee, bare knees and shins, white canvas plimsolls, her left hand on the honey oak handrail. Exactly as in the start frame.
